en.s: The Battle of Xiangji Temple (Chinese: 香積寺之戰; pinyin: Xiāngjīsì zhī zhàn) was a pitched battle of the An Lushan rebellion during Medieval China, between loyalist forces of Tang dynasty and the usurping Yan dynasty. The campaign was launched by Tang forces to recapture the fallen imperial capital Chang'an from the Yan rebels, who met them in a field battle near Xiangji Temple southwest of the capital.

zh.s: 香积寺之战是安史之乱期间唐军与篡立燕朝的军队之间的一场野战。唐军为收复被燕军攻陷的都城长安而发动战役，双方在长安西南的香积寺附近交战。

en.s: The St. Brice's Day massacre was the killing of Danes in the Kingdom of England on 13 November 1002, ordered by King Æthelred the Unready.

zh.s: 1002年11月13日，英格兰王国境内的丹麦人遭到杀害。这场屠杀由英格兰国王“未备者”埃塞尔雷德下令。

en.s: The siege of Qalaa of Beni Hammad (November 1015 – May 20, 1016) was conducted by the Zirid army of Emir Al-Mu'izz in modern-day province of M'sila, Algeria, during the Hammadid–Zirid War. The defenders of the Qala'a were under the command of the Hammadid Emir Hammad ibn Buluggin. The siege ended with the death of Badis ibn al-Mansur, resulting in a Hammadid victory and the Zirid army returning to Ifriqiya.

zh.t: 1015年贝尼哈马德堡围城战开始
zh.s: 1015年11月13日，齐里德军队围攻今阿尔及利亚姆西拉省的贝尼哈马德堡。守军由哈马德王朝的哈马德·伊本·布卢金统领。这场围城持续到1016年5月，最终齐里德军队撤离，哈马德王朝获胜。
zh.n: 本条记录的是围城战开始日期，依据来源信息框。

en.s: The Battle of Alnwick is one of two battles fought near the town of Alnwick, in Northumberland, England. In the battle, which occurred on 13 November 1093, Malcolm III of Scotland, also known as Malcolm Canmore, was killed together with his son Edward, by an army of knights led by Robert de Mowbray.

zh.s: 阿尔尼克附近曾发生过两场战役，其中一场于1093年11月13日发生在英格兰诺森伯兰郡。苏格兰国王马尔科姆三世（又称马尔科姆·坎莫尔）与其子爱德华在战斗中被罗伯特·德·莫布雷率领的骑士军队杀死。

en.t: Battle of Alnwick: in an English victory over the Scots, Malcolm III of Scotland, and his son Edward, are killed
en.s: Malcolm III (Middle Irish: Máel Coluim mac Donnchada; Scottish Gaelic: Maol Chaluim mac Dhonnchaidh; died 13 November 1093) was King of Alba (Scotland) from 1058 to 1093. He was later nicknamed "Canmore" (Scottish Gaelic: ceann mòr, lit. 'big head', understood as "great chief"). Malcolm's long reign of 35 years preceded the beginning of the Scoto-Norman age.

zh.t: 阿尼克战役：苏格兰国王马尔科姆三世及其子爱德华在英格兰获胜的战斗中阵亡
zh.s: 马尔科姆三世（中古爱尔兰语：Máel Coluim mac Donnchada；苏格兰盖尔语：Maol Chaluim mac Dhonnchaidh；1093年11月13日逝世）于1058年至1093年担任阿尔巴国王（苏格兰国王）。他后来获得“卡那摩尔”称号（苏格兰盖尔语：ceann mòr，意为“大头”，也被理解为“伟大领袖”）。他长达35年的统治开启了苏格兰—诺曼时代。

en.s: The city of Danzig (Gdańsk) was captured by the State of the Teutonic Order on 13 November 1308, resulting in a massacre of its inhabitants and marking the beginning of tensions between Poland and the Teutonic Order. Originally the knights moved into the fortress as an ally of Poland against the Margraviate of Brandenburg.

zh.t: 条顿骑士团攻占但泽（格但斯克）
zh.s: 1308年11月13日，条顿骑士团国攻占但泽（格但斯克），随后屠杀当地居民，也由此引发波兰与条顿骑士团之间的紧张关系。骑士团最初以波兰盟友的身份进入当地要塞，协助波兰对抗勃兰登堡边疆伯国。

en.s: The Battle on the Planta, fought on 13 November 1475 around Conthey near Sion, Valais, Switzerland, was part of the Burgundian Wars.

zh.s: 普兰塔战役于1475年11月13日在瑞士瓦莱州锡永附近的孔泰一带进行，是勃艮第战争的一部分。

en.s: The siege of Bergen op Zoom was a siege that took place between September 23 - November 13, 1588, during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). The siege took place in the aftermath of the Spanish Armada when famed commander Alexander Farnese, the Duke of Parma attempted to use his forces to besiege Bergen op Zoom, which was held by an Anglo-Dutch force under Thomas Morgan and Peregrine Bertie.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1588年9月23日至11月13日，八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604）期间，贝亨奥普佐姆遭到围困。西班牙无敌舰队战败后，帕尔马公爵亚历山大·法尔内塞试图率军围攻贝亨奥普佐姆，当时该城由托马斯·摩根和佩里格林·伯蒂率领的英荷联军守卫。

en.s: The Battle of Turnham Green occurred 13 November 1642 near the village of Turnham Green, at the end of the first campaigning season of the First English Civil War. The battle resulted in a standoff between the forces of King Charles I and the much larger Parliamentarian army under the command of the Earl of Essex. In blocking the Royalist army's way to London, however, the Parliamentarians gained an important strategic victory as the standoff forced Charles and his army to retreat to Oxford for secure winter quarters.

zh.s: 特恩汉姆格林战役于1642年11月13日在特恩汉姆格林村附近发生，是第一次英国内战首个作战季末的一场战斗。查理一世国王的军队与埃塞克斯伯爵率领、规模大得多的议会军对峙，双方未分胜负。不过，议会军挡住了保王党军队进军伦敦的道路，取得重要战略胜利；对峙迫使查理和他的军队撤到牛津，寻找安全的冬季驻地。

en.s: The siege of Rethymno happened during the Cretan War when the Ottomans launched a campaign to conquer the city of Rethymno in Crete from the Venetians. The Ottomans captured the city in the end.

zh.s: 雷西姆诺围城战发生在克里特战争期间，奥斯曼军队发动战役，试图从威尼斯共和国手中夺取克里特岛雷西姆诺城。最终，奥斯曼军队攻占了该城。

en.s: The Battle of Knocknanauss was fought in 1647, during the Irish Confederate Wars, part of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, between Confederate Ireland’s Munster army and an English Parliamentarian army under Murrough O’Brien. The battle resulted in a crushing defeat for the Irish Confederates.

zh.s: 诺克纳努斯战役发生于1647年，属于三王国战争中的爱尔兰邦联战争。爱尔兰邦联的蒙斯特军团与穆罗·奥布莱恩率领的英格兰议会军交战，爱尔兰邦联军队惨败。

en.s: The siege of Bangkok was a key event of the Siamese revolution of 1688, in which the Kingdom of Siam ousted the French from Siam. Following a coup d'état, in which the pro-Western king Narai was replaced by Phetracha, Siamese troops besieged the French fortress in Bangkok for four months. The Siamese were able to muster about 40,000 troops, equipped with cannon, against the entrenched 200 French troops, but the military confrontation proved inconclusive.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 曼谷围城战是1688年暹罗革命中的重要事件。暹罗推翻了法国在暹罗的势力。政变推翻亲西方的那莱王、由佩特拉差继位后，暹罗军队围困曼谷的法国堡垒长达4个月。暹罗军队约有4万人，配备大炮；法军据守堡垒，仅有200人，但双方交战没有分出胜负。

en.s: The Battle of the Desna, also known as the Crossing of the Desna River, was a three-day operation which took place on 11 to 13 November 1708 during the Swedish invasion of Russia of the Great Northern War. The Swedes under Charles XII tried to prevent the Russians from seizing the town of Baturyn, by crossing the river of Desna near Mezyn (present-day Novhorod-Siverskyi Raion, Ukraine) which was strongly defended by the Russian Army of 4,000 men under Ludwig Nicolaus von Hallart.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1708年11月11日至13日，瑞典入侵俄罗斯期间，瑞典军队在杰斯纳河渡河行动中试图阻止俄军夺取巴图林。这场行动持续3天，瑞典军队在查理十二世率领下于乌克兰现今新霍罗德-锡韦尔斯基区梅津附近渡河。当地由路德维希·尼古拉斯·冯·哈拉特率领的4000名俄军严密防守。

en.s: The Battle of Thanesar (1710) was one among a series of battles fought between Nawab Firuz Khan Mewati and Governor Binod Singh as he was ordered by the Mughal Imperial government to chastise the Sikh rebellion. Firuz Khan was sent in the vanguard while Sayyid Wajih-ud-din of the Sadaat-e-Bara was sent to reinforce him. It resulted in a victory for the Mughals as Nawab Firuz Khan Mewati cleared Thanesar, in northern India.

zh.s: 1710年塔内萨尔战役是纳瓦布菲鲁兹·汗·梅瓦蒂与总督比诺德·辛格之间一系列战斗之一。莫卧儿帝国政府命令辛格镇压锡克人叛乱。菲鲁兹·汗被派往前锋，巴拉氏族的赛义德·瓦吉赫丁则被派去增援。莫卧儿军队获胜，纳瓦布菲鲁兹·汗·梅瓦蒂攻下了印度北部的塔内萨尔。

en.s: The Battle of Sheriffmuir (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Sliabh an t-Siorraim, [pl̪ˠaɾ ˈʃʎiəv əɲ ˈtʲʰirˠəm]) was an engagement in 1715 at the height of the Jacobite rising in Scotland. The battlefield has been included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009. Sheriffmuir is a remote elevated plateau of moorland lying between Stirling and Auchterarder on the north fringe of the Ochil Hills.

zh.s: 1715年11月13日，苏格兰詹姆斯党起义期间，双方在谢里夫缪尔交战。战场是一片位于斯特灵与奥赫特拉德之间、奥希尔山北缘的高地荒原。

en.s: The 1780 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 13, 1780, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Incumbent Governor Thomas Sim Lee was easily re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1780年11月13日，马里兰州举行州长选举。现任州长托马斯·西姆·李在没有对手的情况下，由马里兰州议会轻松连任。具体票数不详。

en.s: The Battle of Anderlecht, sometimes referred to as the Fight of Anderlecht, took place in Anderlecht near Brussels, capital of the Austrian Netherlands (now Belgium). It was fought between the Habsburg monarchy and the French Republic on 13 November 1792, during the first year of the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 安德莱赫特战役又称安德莱赫特之战，发生在布鲁塞尔附近的安德莱赫特。当时该地属于奥属尼德兰，如今位于比利时。1792年11月13日，哈布斯堡君主国与法兰西共和国在此交战。这是法国大革命战争第一年的一场战役。

en.s: The 1797 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 13, 1797, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Federalist candidate and incumbent United States Senator John Henry was easily elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1797年11月13日，马里兰州举行州长选举。联邦党候选人、时任美国参议员约翰·亨利在没有对手的情况下，由马里兰州议会轻松选出。具体票数不详。

en.s: The Battle of Deeg, fought on 13 November 1804, took place outside Deeg, now in the Bharatpur district of Rajasthan, India, then within the territories of the Maratha Empire. It was part of the Second Anglo-Maratha War. A force of the British East India Company led by Major General Fraser defeated a Maratha force. Fraser was himself mortally wounded in the attack. The British captured about 87 guns of the enemy's 160. British casualties were over 640 killed or wounded. Maratha casualties were estimated at over 2,000. The British loss was heavy - 643 killed and wounded," including General Fraser.

zh.s: 迪格战役于1804年11月13日在迪格城外发生。迪格现属印度拉贾斯坦邦巴拉特布尔县，当时属于马拉塔帝国。第二次英马拉塔战争期间，弗雷泽少将率领的英国东印度公司部队击败马拉塔军队，弗雷泽本人在进攻中受了致命伤。英军缴获敌军160门火炮中的约87门。英军伤亡超过640人，马拉塔军队估计有2,000多人伤亡。英军损失惨重，共有643人伤亡，其中包括弗雷泽将军。

en.s: The Capitulation of Dornbirn (13 November 1805) saw the French VII Corps under Marshal Pierre Augereau face an Austrian force led by Feldmarschall-Leutnant (FML) Franz Jellacic. Isolated near Lake Constance (Bodensee) by superior numbers of French troops, Jellacic surrendered the infantry and artillery under his command. However, his cavalry managed to escape to Bohemia. The event occurred during the War of the Third Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1805年11月13日，多恩比恩投降。皮埃尔·奥热罗元帅率领的法国第七军团与弗朗茨·耶拉契奇中将率领的奥军对峙。耶拉契奇的部队在博登湖附近被人数占优的法军孤立后，他交出了麾下步兵和炮兵，但骑兵成功逃往波希米亚。这一事件发生在第三次反法同盟战争期间，该战争是拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The November 1809 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 13, 1809, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Edward Lloyd was re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly against Federalist candidates former United States senator Charles Carroll, Levin Winder, Benjamin Stoddart and former governor John Eager Howard.

zh.s: 1809年11月13日，马里兰州举行州长选举。现任民主共和党州长爱德华·劳埃德再次当选，击败了联邦党候选人、前美国参议员查尔斯·卡罗尔、莱文·温德、本杰明·斯托达特以及前州长约翰·伊格·霍华德。

en.s: The Battle of Nowo Schwerschen (Novy Sverzhen) was fought on Friday, 13 November 1812, near Novy Sverzhen or Nowo Schwerschen, part of the Russian Empire at the time (now in Belarus). An unexperienced Polish force under General Franciszek Ksawery Kossecki was defeated by seasoned Russian forces led by Count Lambert from Admiral Chichagov's Army of the Danube.

zh.s: 新斯韦尔申战役（Новый Свержень，Nowo Schwerschen）于1812年11月13日星期五在新斯韦尔申附近进行。当时这里属于俄罗斯帝国，如今位于白俄罗斯。弗朗齐谢克·克萨维里·科谢茨基将军率领的波兰部队经验不足，被兰贝尔伯爵率领、来自奇恰戈夫多瑙河军团的俄军击败。

en.s: The Battle of Nanticoke Creek was a small engagement fought on November 13, 1813, near Nanticoke, Ontario, Canada, during the War of 1812.

zh.s: 1813年11月13日，1812年战争期间，加拿大安大略省南蒂科克附近发生了一场小规模交战，史称南蒂科克溪战役。

zh.s: 法国于1820年11月4日和13日举行了部分立法选举。

en.s: The 1837 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 13. Incumbent Whig Governor Edward Everett was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Democrat Marcus Morton.

zh.s: 1837年11月13日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任辉格党州长爱德华·埃弗里特再次当选，开始第三个任期，击败了民主党候选人马库斯·莫顿。

en.s: The First Herat War (Persian: جنگ اول هرات, romanized: Jang-e Avval-e Herāt; 1837–1838) was an attack on the Principality of Herat by Qajar Iran during the Great Game. Herat was held by Kamran Shah and his vizier Yar Mohammad Khan Alakozai. The Shah of Iran was Mohammad Shah Qajar. Four Europeans were involved: the British, Sir John McNeill and Eldred Pottinger as well as the Russians, Count Simonich and Jan Prosper Witkiewicz.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次赫拉特战争（波斯语：جنگ اول هرات，转写：Jang-e Avval-e Herāt；1837—1838）是大博弈期间卡扎尔王朝伊朗对赫拉特公国发动的进攻。当时赫拉特由卡姆兰沙和其宰相亚尔·穆罕默德汗·阿拉科扎伊统治，伊朗国王为穆罕默德·沙·卡扎尔。四名欧洲人参与其中：英国人约翰·麦克尼尔爵士和埃尔德雷德·波廷格，以及俄国人西蒙尼奇伯爵和扬·普罗斯珀·维特凯维奇。

en.s: The siege of Kalat was a military campaign against the Khanate of Kalat led by the British during the First Anglo-Afghan War. The fortress of Khelat, held by a Baluchi tribal chief, threatened communications with India through the Bolan Pass. The unfriendly Baluchi tribes had harassed and attacked British convoys and killed officers and camp followers alike during the First Anglo-Afghan War. As retaliation, the Bombay Column stormed the fortress on 13 November 1839 on its way back to India.

zh.s: 英国在第一次英阿战争期间对卡拉特汗国发动军事行动，史称卡拉特围城战。俾路支部族首领控制的凯拉特堡威胁到英国经博兰山口通往印度的交通线。第一次英阿战争期间，不友好的俾路支部族曾袭击英国车队，杀害军官和随军人员。作为报复，孟买纵队于1839年11月13日在返回印度途中攻占这座堡垒。

en.s: The 1843–44 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 13, 1843. The result of the election was inconclusive, as no candidate won a majority of the popular vote. The Massachusetts General Court held a contingent election on January 8, 1844, in which the Whig Party nominee George N. Briggs defeated the incumbent Democratic governor Marcus Morton.

zh.s: 1843年11月13日举行的马萨诸塞州州长选举结果未定，没有候选人获得多数普选票。1844年1月8日，马萨诸塞州议会举行后续选举，辉格党候选人乔治·N·布里格斯击败了现任民主党州长马库斯·莫顿。

en.s: The 1848–49 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of an initial popular election held on November 13, 1848 that was followed by a legislative vote held on January 8, 1949. Incumbent Whig Governor George N. Briggs was reelected.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州州长选举先于1848年11月13日举行民众投票，随后于1849年1月8日由州议会投票决定。时任辉格党州长乔治·N·布里格斯成功连任。

en.s: The 1849 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 13, 1849, in order to elect the first Lieutenant Governor of California upon California acquiring statehood on September 9, 1850. Candidate John McDougal defeated candidate Richard Roman, candidate John B. Frisbie, candidate Francis J. Lippitt, candidate A. M. Winn, candidate and former Supreme Judge of the Provisional Government of Oregon Peter Hardeman Burnett and candidate Pablo de la Guerra.

zh.t: 1849年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1849年11月13日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举，以选出加利福尼亚州首任副州长；加利福尼亚州于1850年9月9日成为州。约翰·麦克杜格尔击败了理查德·罗曼、约翰·B·弗里斯比、弗朗西斯·J·利皮特、A·M·温恩、俄勒冈临时政府前最高法官彼得·哈德曼·伯内特和巴勃罗·德拉格拉。

en.s: The 1849 California gubernatorial election was held on November 13, 1849, to elect the first governor of California. Peter Hardeman Burnett won in a five-way race. Burnett was subsequently sworn in as governor on December 20, 1849, with the military governor, Bennet C. Riley, ceding de facto executive authority to him. However, California did not officially become a state until September 9, 1850, as part of the Compromise of 1850.

zh.s: 1849年11月13日，加利福尼亚举行州长选举，选出首任州长。彼得·哈德曼·伯内特在五人角逐中获胜。他于1849年12月20日宣誓就任州长，军事总督贝内特·C·莱利将实际行政权交给他。加利福尼亚州直到1850年9月9日才正式加入联邦，这是1850年妥协案的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Akhaltsikhe (Russian: Ахалцихское сражение, Georgian: ახალციხის ბრძოლა) occurred on 13 November 1853 during the Crimean War when a Georgian-Russian force of 7,000 defeated a Turkish army of 18,000 men near the Akhaltsikhe fortress in the Caucasus. At the outbreak of the Crimean War, Ali Pasha immediately launched a Turkish offensive to capture the Akhaltsikhe fortress.

en.s: The Battle of Estancia de las Vacas took place on November 13, 1859 in the vicinity of Estancia Cows in the state of Querétaro, Mexico, between elements of the liberal army, under General Santos Degollado and elements of the conservative army commanded by General Miguel Miramón during the Reform War. The victory corresponded to the conservative side that won despite the Liberals were doubled in number.

zh.t: 埃斯坦西亚德拉斯瓦卡斯战役
zh.s: 埃斯坦西亚德拉斯瓦卡斯战役于1859年11月13日在墨西哥克雷塔罗州埃斯坦西亚德拉斯瓦卡斯附近发生。改革战争期间，桑托斯·德戈亚多将军率领的自由派军队与米格尔·米拉蒙将军指挥的保守派军队交战。尽管自由派人数是对方的两倍，仍由保守派获胜。

en.s: The 1862–63 United States Senate elections were held from January 4, 1862, to November 13, 1863. Regularly scheduled elections were held for 20 out of the 70 seats in the United States Senate, and special elections were held in Indiana, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, New Jersey, Oregon, and Rhode Island. The Republican–Union coalition retained their majority despite an unfavorable national environment.

The incumbent Conservative coalition administration, led by Frederick Carter, supported Confederation.

en.s: The Battle of El Herri (also known as Elhri) was fought between France and the Berber Zaian Confederation on 13 November 1914. It took place at the small settlement of El Herri, near Khénifra in the French protectorate in Morocco. The battle was part of the Zaian War, in which the confederation of tribes sought to oppose continued French expansion into the interior of Morocco. Having captured the strategic town of Khénifra earlier in the year, the French, under General Hubert Lyautey, entered negotiations with Mouha ou Hammou Zayani, who led the Zaian.

zh.s: 埃尔赫里战役发生于1914年11月13日，交战双方是法国军队和柏柏尔人的扎伊安部族联盟。战斗地点在当时法属摩洛哥的埃尔赫里村，靠近胡尼夫拉。该战役属于扎伊安战争，部族联盟试图阻止法国继续向摩洛哥内陆扩张。此前，法军在休伯特·利奥泰将军指挥下攻占战略重镇胡尼夫拉，随后与扎伊安领袖穆哈·乌·哈穆·扎亚尼展开谈判。

en.s: The Battle of Mughar Ridge, officially known by the British as the action of El Mughar, took place on 13 November 1917 during the Pursuit phase of the Southern Palestine Offensive of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign in the First World War. Fighting between the advancing Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) and the retreating Yildirim Army Group, occurred after the Battle of Beersheba and the Third Battle of Gaza.

zh.s: 穆加尔岭战役于1917年11月13日爆发。英国方面正式称之为埃尔穆加尔战斗，属于第一次世界大战中西奈及巴勒斯坦战役、南巴勒斯坦攻势的追击阶段。推进中的埃及远征军与撤退中的耶尔德勒姆集团军交战；此前，别是巴战役和加沙第三次战役已经结束。

en.s: The Battles of Monte Grappa were a series of three battles which were fought during World War I between the armies of the Austro-Hungarian Empire and the Kingdom of Italy for control of the Monte Grappa massif, as it covered the left flank of the Italian Piave front.
en.n: World War I: beginning of the First Battle of Monte Grappa (in Italy known as the "First Battle of the Piave"). The Austro-Hungarian Armed Forces, despite help from the German Alpenkorps and numerical superiority, will fail their offensive against the Italian Army now led by its new chief of staff Armando Diaz.

zh.s: 蒙特格拉帕战役是第一次世界大战期间发生的三场战斗，交战方为奥匈帝国军队和意大利王国军队，双方争夺蒙特格拉帕山地的控制权。该山地覆盖了意大利皮亚韦河战线的左翼。
zh.n: 第一次世界大战：蒙特格拉帕第一次战役（意大利称“皮亚韦河第一次战役”）开始。尽管德军阿尔卑斯军团提供支援且兵力占优，奥匈军队仍未能击败由新任总参谋长阿曼多·迪亚兹指挥的意大利军队。

en.t: United Kingdom during the Turkish War of Independence
en.s: During the Turkish War of Independence, the United Kingdom sought to undermine and contain the Turkish National Movement. London hoped the defeated Ottoman Empire would play a subservient role in its new Middle Eastern order drawn up over several diplomatic agreements during World War I, culminating with the Treaty of Sèvres. Another goal of the British was to prosecute Ottoman war criminals, whom they believed Constantinople/Istanbul was not taking seriously.

en.s: The Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS) is the highest court in the federal judiciary of the United States. It has ultimate appellate jurisdiction over all U.S. federal court cases, and over state court cases that turn on questions of U.S. constitutional or federal law. It also has original jurisdiction over a narrow range of cases, specifically "all Cases affecting Ambassadors, other public Ministers and Consuls, and those in which a State shall be Party".

zh.t: 美国最高法院裁定公立学校学生必须接种疫苗
zh.s: 美国最高法院是美国联邦司法体系的最高法院，对所有联邦案件以及涉及美国宪法或联邦法律问题的州法院案件拥有最终上诉管辖权。它还对有限类别的案件拥有初审管辖权，具体包括涉及大使、其他外交使节和领事的案件，以及州作为当事方的案件。

The tunnel is operated by the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey and carries Interstate 78. The New Jersey side of the tunnel is the eastern terminus of New Jersey Route 139.

zh.s: 荷兰隧道是一条穿过哈德逊河下方的公路隧道，东连纽约市哈德逊广场和曼哈顿下城，西接新泽西州泽西市。隧道由纽约与新泽西港务局运营，承载78号州际公路。隧道的新泽西一侧是新泽西139号州道的东端。

en.s: The Changsha fire of 1938 (Chinese: 長沙大火), also known as Wenxi fire (Chinese: 文夕大火), was the greatest human-caused urban conflagration in Chinese history. Kuomintang officials ordered the city be set on fire in 1938 during the Second Sino-Japanese War to prevent the Japanese from benefiting from its capture. The result of this fire made Changsha one of the most damaged cities during World War II, alongside Stalingrad, Hiroshima, Nagasaki, Tokyo, Dresden, Warsaw and others.

zh.s: 1938年长沙大火（中文：长沙大火），又称“文夕大火”，是中国历史上人为造成的最大城市火灾。抗日战争期间，国民党官员为防止日军占领长沙后从中获益，下令于1938年焚城。大火使长沙成为二战期间受损最严重的城市之一，与斯大林格勒、广岛、长崎、东京、德累斯顿和华沙等城市并列。

en.s: Fantasia is a 1940 American animated musical anthology film produced by Walt Disney Productions. The third Disney animated feature film, it consists of eight animated segments set to pieces of classical music conducted by Leopold Stokowski, seven of which are performed by the Philadelphia Orchestra. en.s: The Naval Battle of Guadalcanal took place from 12 to 15 November 1942 and was the decisive engagement in a series of naval battles between Allied (primarily American) and Imperial Japanese forces during the months-long Guadalcanal campaign in the Solomon Islands during World War II. en.s: The Action of 13 November 1943 was a submarine engagement of World War II. It resulted in the sinking of the Japanese Navy's Kaidai Junsen Type B1 submarine I-34 in the Strait of Malacca by the British Royal Navy submarine HMS Taurus. I-34 was on a Yanagi Mission, an underwater convoy secretly shipping goods between Japan and their German allies. The Japanese submarine I-34 under commander Irie Tatsushi, departed Kure on the first leg of a "Yanagi" mission to Nazi-occupied France. At the time she was the third Japanese submarine to undertake such a mission.

zh.s: 1943年11月13日的战斗是第二次世界大战期间的一场潜艇交战。英国皇家海军潜艇“金牛座号”在马六甲海峡击沉了日本海军伊-34号乙型海大级潜艇。伊-34号正在执行“柳作战”，秘密向德国盟友运送物资。该艇由入江达志指挥，从吴港出发，开始前往纳粹占领下法国的“柳作战”第一段航程。这是执行该任务的第三艘日本潜艇。

en.t: General Carlos Delgado Chalbaud, President of Venezuela, is assassinated in Caracas
en.s: Carlos Román Delgado Chalbaud (20 January 1909 – 13 November 1950) was a Venezuelan military officer who served as president of Venezuela from 1948 to 1950 as leader of a military junta. en.s: The Guatemalan Civil War was fought from 1960 to 1996 between the government of Guatemala and various leftist rebel groups. The Guatemalan government forces committed genocide against the Maya population of Guatemala during the civil war and there were widespread human rights violations against civilians. The context of the struggle was based on longstanding issues over land distribution. Wealthy Guatemalans, mainly of European descent, and foreign companies like the American United Fruit Company had control over much of the land leading to conflicts with the rural, disproportionately indigenous, peasants who worked the land. Democratic elections in 1944 and 1951 which were during the Guatemalan Revolution had brought popular leftist governments to power, who sought to ameliorate working conditions and implement land distribution. A United States-backed coup d'état in 1954 installed the military regime of Carlos Castillo Armas to prevent reform. Armas was followed by a series of right-wing military dictators. The Civil War began on 13 November 1960, when a group of left-wing junior military officers led a failed revolt against the government of General Ydígoras Fuentes.

zh.s: 危地马拉内战从1960年持续到1996年，交战双方是危地马拉政府和多个左翼叛军组织。内战期间，危地马拉政府军对玛雅人实施了种族灭绝，并广泛侵犯平民人权。冲突根源包括长期存在的土地分配问题。主要由欧洲裔危地马拉人组成的富裕阶层，以及美国联合果品公司等外国企业控制了大部分土地，这与在当地耕作、以原住民为主的农村居民产生冲突。危地马拉革命期间，1944年和1951年的民主选举使受欢迎的左翼政府上台，这些政府试图改善劳动条件并实行土地分配。1954年，美国支持的政变推翻改革，扶植卡洛斯·卡斯蒂略·阿马斯的军政府上台。此后又出现一系列右翼军事独裁者。1960年11月13日，一群由左翼初级军官领导的部队试图起事，未能推翻伊迪戈拉斯·富恩特斯将军政府，内战由此开始。

en.s: The 1960 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the 29th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1960 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.s: The 1966 attack on Samu, codenamed by Israel as Operation Shredder, was a large cross-border assault on 13 November 1966 by the Israeli military on the Jordanian-controlled West Bank village of Samu. en.s: The Knowsley North by-election, 1986 was a parliamentary by-election held on 13 November 1986 for the British House of Commons constituency of Knowsley North. Labour retained the seat with well over half of the votes, while the SDP-Liberal Alliance finished runner-up by attracting more than a third of the votes. Although the Conservative government at the time was just months away from a third successive general election win, the Conservative candidate in this by-election attracted just over 6% of all votes - reflecting the Conservative Party's low popularity on Merseyside, which had some of the highest levels of unemployment in the United Kingdom largely due to the monetarist policies to tackle inflation.

After a careful house-by-house search the next day, police officers led by the Anti-Terrorist Squad (now known as the Special Tactics Group) located Gray and shot him dead as he came out of a house firing from the hip.

en.s: The 2018 Northern Mariana gubernatorial election took place on Tuesday, November 13, 2018, to elect the Governor of the Northern Mariana Islands and the Lieutenant Governor of the Northern Mariana Islands to a four-year term in office. Incumbent Republican governor Ralph Torres, who ascended to governorship in December 2015 following the death of Governor Eloy Inos, sought election to a full term.

zh.t: 2018年北马里亚纳群岛州长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月13日星期二，北马里亚纳群岛举行州长和副州长选举，选出任期四年的官员。现任共和党州长拉尔夫·托雷斯于2015年12月在州长埃洛伊·伊诺斯去世后接任，此次竞选完整任期。

en.s: Gaza-Israel clashes began on 11 November 2018, when a botched Israeli covert operation carried out in the Khan Yunis area of the southern Gaza Strip killed seven Palestinian militants and one Israeli soldier. Exchanges of fire lasted for two more days, until a cease fire was achieved with Egyptian mediation. Some minor incidents and protests followed some two weeks after the cease fire, with decreasing intensity.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 加沙—以色列冲突始于2018年11月11日。当时，以色列在加沙地带南部汗尤尼斯地区的一次秘密行动失败，造成7名巴勒斯坦武装人员和1名以色列士兵死亡。此后双方交火持续两天，直到埃及斡旋达成停火。约两周后发生了一些小规模事件和抗议，强度逐渐减弱。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 2018 Jerusalem municipal election was held on 30 October to elect the mayor and city council of Jerusalem. Incumbent mayor Nir Barkat did not seek re-election. With no mayoral candidate in the first round meeting the vote threshold of 40% needed to avoid a runoff election, a runoff was held on 13 November, Which was won by Moshe Lion.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷于2018年10月30日举行市政选举，选出市长和市议会成员。现任市长尼尔·巴尔卡特没有竞选连任。首轮投票中没有市长候选人达到避免第二轮投票所需的40%门槛，因此于11月13日举行第二轮投票，摩西·利昂获胜。
zh.n: 本条记录采用来源资料框标注的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: Clashes between Morocco and the Polisario Front's Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR) broke out in the disputed region of Western Sahara in November 2020. It was the latest escalation of an unresolved conflict over the region, of which 75–80% is occupied by Morocco. The violence ended a 1991 ceasefire between the opposing sides that had held for 29 years in anticipation of an indefinitely stalled referendum on self-determination that would have settled the dispute.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2020年11月13日，摩洛哥与波利萨里奥阵线在有争议的西撒哈拉地区再次发生武装冲突。双方自1991年以来维持了29年的停火因此结束；原本用于解决争端的民族自决公投长期未能举行。
zh.n: 本条记录的是这一轮冲突的开始日期，依据来源信息框。

en.s: The 2021 New Orleans mayoral election was held on November 13, 2021, to elect the mayor of New Orleans, Louisiana. Originally scheduled to be held on October 9, 2021, the election was delayed five weeks by Louisiana Governor John Bel Edwards following heavy damage in the city by Hurricane Ida. A runoff was scheduled for December 11, 2021, but was ultimately unnecessary.

zh.s: 2021年11月13日，新奥尔良举行市长选举。选举原定于10月9日举行，因艾达飓风给该市造成严重损失，路易斯安那州州长约翰·贝尔·爱德华兹将选举推迟了五周。原定于12月11日举行的第二轮投票最终没有必要举行。

en.s: On 13 November 2021, Indian state forces engaged with Maoist insurgents, resulting in the Gadchiroli clash. The firefight lasted for 10 hours, and the Indian forces successfully managed to clear the area, killing 26 insurgents while only sustaining 3 injuries. One of the insurgents killed was Milind Teltumbde, one of the senior commanders of the Naxalite insurgency.

zh.s: 2021年11月13日，印度政府军与毛派叛乱分子交战，引发加德奇罗利冲突。交火持续了10小时，印度政府军控制了该地区，打死26名叛乱分子，自身有3人受伤。死者之一是纳萨尔派叛乱组织高级指挥官米林德·泰尔图姆德。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Holloway vs. Rodríguez
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Holloway vs. Rodríguez (also known as UFC Fight Night 197, UFC Vegas 42 and UFC on ESPN+ 55) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 13, 2021, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：霍洛威对阵罗德里格斯
zh.s: 终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事“UFC格斗之夜：霍洛威对阵罗德里格斯”也称UFC格斗之夜197、UFC拉斯维加斯42和UFC on ESPN+ 55。赛事于2021年11月13日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行，该地属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2022 CAF Women's Champions League Final was the final match of the 2022 CAF Women's Champions League, the second edition of Africa's premier women's club football tournament organised by CAF. It was played at Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium in Rabat, Morocco on 13 November 2022.

zh.t: 2022年非洲足联女子冠军联赛决赛
zh.s: 2022年非洲足联女子冠军联赛决赛是该赛事第二届比赛的决赛，也是非洲足联组织的非洲顶级女子俱乐部足球赛事的一部分。比赛于2022年11月13日在摩洛哥拉巴特的穆莱·阿卜杜拉王子体育场举行。

en.s: The 2022 FAI Cup final, known as the 2022 Extra.ie FAI Cup final for sponsorship reasons, was the final match of the 2022 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on Sunday 13 November at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin and was contested by Derry City and Shelbourne. Over 32,000 spectators attended the match.

zh.s: 2022年爱尔兰足协杯决赛因赞助冠名也称2022年Extra.ie爱尔兰足协杯决赛，是爱尔兰共和国全国足球杯赛2022赛季的决赛。比赛于11月13日星期日在都柏林阿维瓦体育场举行，由德里城对阵谢尔伯恩，现场观众超过3.2万人。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Slovenia on 23 October 2022. Incumbent President Borut Pahor was ineligible to run for a third consecutive term due to term limits. As no candidate received a majority of the vote, a runoff between the top two placing candidates, former foreign minister Anže Logar, an SDS member running as an independent, and independent former Information Commissioner Nataša Pirc Musar, took place on 13 November 2022.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 斯洛文尼亚于2022年10月23日举行总统选举。由于任期限制，现任总统博鲁特·帕霍尔不能连续第三次参选。首轮投票中没有候选人获得多数票，因此排名前两位的候选人——曾任外交部长、以独立候选人身份参选的民主党成员安热·洛加尔，以及独立参选的前信息专员娜塔莎·皮尔茨·穆萨尔——于2022年11月13日参加第二轮投票。

en.s: On 13 November 2023, the Arakan Army (AA), an ethnic resistance group active in the civil war in Myanmar, launched a military offensive against Myanmar's military junta in Rakhine and southern Chin State. Fighting began alongside the launch of Operation 1027, in which the Arakan Army participated as a member of the Three Brotherhood Alliance.

zh.s: 2023年11月13日，缅甸内战中的民族抵抗组织若开军向缅甸军政府发动攻势，战事发生在若开邦和钦邦南部。行动与“1027行动”同时展开，若开军是三兄弟联盟的成员之一。

en.s: Wayanad Lok Sabha by-election was held on 13 November 2024. In the previous election held months prior, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi was elected from two seats, Wayanad and Rae Bareli. Indian law states that while one can contest multiple seats in an election, they can only remain an MP for one. Thus, Gandhi resigned from Wayanad thereby causing a by-election.

zh.s: 2024年11月13日举行瓦亚纳德人民院补选。此前数月，国大党领袖拉胡尔·甘地在瓦亚纳德和赖巴雷利两个选区都当选。印度法律允许候选人在一次选举中竞选多个席位，但议员只能保留一个席位，因此甘地辞去了瓦亚纳德席位，引发补选。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Somaliland on 13 November 2024. In the election, incumbent President Muse Bihi Abdi of the Kulmiye party was seeking a second and final term in office against the opposition candidates Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi "Irro" of the Waddani party, and Faysal Ali Warabe of the UCID party. The election was held concurrently with an election to determine the three national political parties for the next decade.

zh.s: 2024年11月13日，索马里兰举行总统选举。现任总统穆斯·比希·阿卜迪代表库尔米耶党竞选第二个、也是最后一个任期；反对派候选人包括瓦达尼党候选人阿卜迪拉赫曼·穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉希（“伊罗”）和UCID党候选人费萨尔·阿里·瓦拉贝。选举同时确定未来10年的三个全国性政党。

en.s: On November 13, 2024, Republican members of the United States Senate held an election to determine the next leader of the Senate Republican Conference, who was to become the next majority leader of the United States Senate at the start of the 119th U.S. Congress. Republicans had regained control of the chamber in the 2024 election, flipping one Independent and three Democratic seats and securing a 53–47 majority.

zh.t: 2024年美国参议院共和党会议领导人选举
zh.s: 2024年11月13日，美国参议院共和党议员举行选举，选出下一任参议院共和党会议领导人；此人将在第119届国会开始时成为参议院多数党领袖。共和党在2024年选举中重新控制参议院，赢得53比47的多数席位，其中包括从民主党手中赢得3席，以及从独立人士手中赢得1席。
